articles.title: Oscar Piastri questions "strange" pace deficit to other Mercedes-powered cars in Las Vegas

articles.summary_fr: Oscar Piastri a exprimé son étonnement face à l'écart de vitesse de la McLaren par rapport aux concurrents équipés du même moteur Mercedes à Las Vegas. Il a obtenu la septième meilleure vitesse en qualification finale.
articles.summary_en: Oscar Piastri expressed surprise at the McLaren's speed gap compared to rivals using the same Mercedes power unit in Las Vegas, acknowledging the unexpected margin. He recorded the seventh-fastest time in the final qualifying session.

articles.summary_en: Max Verstappen secured the Las Vegas pole with a time of 1m34.151, 0.258 seconds behind Kimi Antonelli. The champion had to resolve technical issues late on Friday.

articles.title: Why Mercedes' tow plan for George Russell fell apart in Las Vegas

articles.summary_en: Isack Hadjar admitted he performed poorly in Las Vegas qualifying, failing to grasp the tow's power. He was 0.67s slower than Verstappen in Q2 and 0.44s in Q3, finishing fifth.

articles.title: Pirelli’s F1 tyres still can’t cope with Losail: Maximum stint lengths imposed again | Formula 1
